sections.title: Look Back (Review)
paragraphs: Eventually, God allowed both Israel and Judah to be conquered by other nations and His temple to be destroyed. Finally, after many years in exile, the children of Israel were allowed to return. Through it all, they were waiting for God to send His Savior, and this story is according to the word of God.

sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: The Bible teaches that after many years of silence; God spoke and sent the angel of the Lord to a virgin girl named Mary. Mary was a descendent of Abraham and King David. The angel told Mary that although she had never been with a man, she would give birth to a son who would be conceived by the Holy Spirit. He would be Christ the Savior whom people had been waiting for many years. His mission would be to save people from their sins.
Let’s read some verses from the Holy Scriptures, the Bible, that relate to this story.

These verses teach us that God came near to us. He did not come first to the powerful, but to ordinary and fearful people. He does not ask us to purify ourselves and seek Him out, but in all His holiness, He came to us! The deep beauty and wonder of Jesus' birth is that God came to us not in power, but in weakness like our own, as a baby. And this good news is for all people.
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little — how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Does God seem far away, or does his nearness make you afraid? God chose to come near because he loves us. Thank God for this good news!
I hope you enjoyed this story. When can we meet again?
Do you think someone else should hear this story?
